external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Users are either admins or viewers.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice email and views the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: An agent who works from the support office network and uses the admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The invoicing application used by customer users, which reads and writes tenant data, enqueues render jobs, and fetches PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A renderer that consumes jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time, reads the invoice from the tenant database and writes the PDF to the PDF bucket

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: The console used by support agents to open sessions in the billing app as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column; the database has no row-level security; the app uses one database account for all companies.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs containing a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket where the PDF renderer writes PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time, reads the invoice from the tenant database and writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number.
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs with one service credential for all companies.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user uses the billing app, including signing in and performing billing actions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer information, payout bank details, credentials, and session cookie

data_flows.name: request PDF
data_flows.description: A customer user asks the billing app for a PDF of an invoice.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Any user can ask for a PDF of any invoice, as often as they like.
data_flows.data_description: A request identifying an invoice for PDF rendering

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: A payer opens the invoice payment page and views the invoice, company name, and bank details.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and bank details

data_flows.name: send invoice email
data_flows.description: The billing app sends an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number to the payer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link containing an invoice number

data_flows.name: read and write records
data_flows.description: The billing app queries and saves invoices, customer information, and payout bank details in the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer information, payout bank details, company IDs, and invoice fields including the paid flag

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app places a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number in a render job

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.data_description: Invoice data

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a PDF under the company ID and invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID carried by the job.
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF, company ID, and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Account credentials and one-time code

data_flows.name: open customer session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as a customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.data_description: Customer user session identity

data_flows.name: act as customer user
data_flows.description: A support agent performs actions in the billing app through the session opened as a customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Everything the agent then does is recorded in the tenant database against that customer user, and not against the agent.
data_flows.data_description: Billing-app actions and customer-user session identity

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: The tenant or organizational boundary of a customer company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform in which the shared billing app, database, and PDF bucket operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and from which the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The billing app, PDF renderer, tenant database, render queue, and PDF bucket are placed in the cloud platform zone because the description says the shared system components are in that platform.
assumptions.basis: The description says the companies share the billing app, database, and PDF bucket in 'our cloud platform'; the renderer and queue are described as part of the same PDF-rendering system.

assumptions.assumption: The cloud platform is represented as a network trust boundary.
assumptions.basis: The description identifies the cloud platform as the shared location for system components but does not state a different authority or tenant boundary for it.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It stores PDFs rendered from invoices, including invoice and bank-detail information.
